recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. Revisit only if a future work group decision asks for a new semantic constraint or additional Group/List boundary text beyond the wording already applied for FHIR-27903 and the supporting FHIR-27083 guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-27903 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core FHIR-I issue raised against R4 List and Group. It asked to reduce ambiguity between the resources by expanding the List description with examples such as problem, allergy, facility, and organization lists and by adding that a List cannot be the subject of an intervention or direct action.
initial_application: Commits f79aa963d84 and 33ba1604c0 explicitly applied FHIR-27903 on 2022-08-10: f79aa963d84 added the direct-action/intervention sentence to source/list/list-introduction.xml and expanded the StructureDefinition description, while 33ba1604c0 expanded the root List definition. Current blame still identifies those commits on the relevant lines.
additional_context: FHIR-27083 is the closely related List/Group family decision that declined merging the resources and added guidance preferring Group when a collection can be a subject of measures, observations, communications, or similar actions. FHIR-I minutes on 2020-10-26 confirmed the FHIR-27903 motion. The existing combined-branch FHIR-14875 audit treats FHIR-27903 as a later clarification in the broader collection-resource guidance family. source/fhir.ini lists Group and List as active and approved, so the inspected List source is current build scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/list/structuredefinition-List.xml already contains the requested expanded List description in both the resource description and root definition, and source/list/list-introduction.xml already says a List cannot be the subject of an intervention or direct action.

related_jiras.note: Published List/Group merge request cited in FHIR-27903 comments; it supported keeping the resources distinct and adding Group-preference guidance.
Existing combined-branch no-change audit for broader collection resource guidance cites FHIR-27903 as a later List clarification.
